checks: tools are deterministic, read-only and cite only existing event and action ids
controller events, resolved actions, utterances and state changes are observed outcomes; memory meanings are agent interpretations
utterances are labeled unverified; authored background is not reported as an interpretation; recipients are listed
an outline citing unknown evidence is repaired, and fails after two repairs
observed claims cite only observed outcomes; agent-interpretation claims need an interpretation item
claims citing evidence outside their section, untyped claims and uncited claims are rejected
a full report leaves the checkpoint unchanged
rendering labels every model claim by type and keeps executed tool results in a separate appendix
an unavailable graph search is logged as a tool error, never turned into evidence

mutation_checks: accepting an observed claim that cites interpretation evidence is caught
filing utterances as agent interpretations is caught
turning a failed graph search into evidence is caught
reporting authored background as an agent interpretation is caught
scope: Engineering integration only. Report claims are checked for citation and type discipline, not truth; the simulation is fictional.
